statement: the takeover itself is complete and proven; the blocker is that the upstream test files the file-plan expects to be placed bring fifteen non-green cases into ./pkg/..., which the verify-gpu test line runs

deterministic_failures.cause: transport_test.go:11 compares reflect.DeepEqual(KindAsynq, o.Kind()); KindAsynq is the untyped constant "asynq" (transport.go:8) while Kind() returns transport.Kind, so the two values never compare equal
http_test.go:129 expects a nil error from reading one SSE event and gets errors.errorString{"timeout"}
server_test.go:157 expects the literal bytes "evt-001" while the implementation writes a generated 32-hex identifier
transport_test.go:16, the same untyped-constant comparison as asynq, for KindSse
transport_test.go:12, the same untyped-constant comparison, for KindKeepalive

never_terminating.cause: server_test.go:42-72: the body ends in signal.Notify + <-interrupt, so it waits for a real process signal; the file also dials redis://:*Abcd123456@127.0.0.1:6379
stream.go:64 in Stream.run: the handler waits for an event that the test never produces, so the response body never completes
server_test.go:75: Publish onto an existing stream with no reader, the test then blocks on a channel nothing writes to
server_test.go:102: the same shape for a non-existent stream
keepalive server.go:82-114: Start calls Serve and only returns after Shutdown, so the upstream test asserting a nil return from Start can never get there

inheritance_proof.method: the same per-test command run against byte-identical, import-UNrewritten copies of the locked modules placed in a disposable worktree of ce28159, built with the repository's own dependency selections
inheritance_proof.result: all fifteen reproduce identically on the control: 5 fail with the same assertion text and 10 time out; none is caused by the rewrite
inheritance_proof.log: migration/patches/T11/T11-placed-tests.jsonl and the control records in this file

why_the_task_cannot_close_it: deleting, skipping, tagging or re-writing the expectations of these fifteen cases is a new test exclusion: the approved exception sets are the nine T04 captcha cases and the three T10 order-id cases, and the standing instruction is explicitly not to widen them on my own

the six asynq harnesses also dial a hardcoded redis://:*Abcd123456@127.0.0.1:6379; the current boundaries forbid using the default localhost Redis, so even a bounded rewrite would need a task-private Redis plus a decision about the hardcoded URI
leaving them as they are means make verify-gpu's ./pkg/... line panics each of the four affected packages after its 20-minute test timeout and the milestone can never be reported green
options_for_a_ruling: A: test-only repair where the assertion is simply wrong (the three Kind comparisons, and the two SSE cases after a cause ruling), and precise isolation of the ten never-terminating harness cases behind upstream_known_defects with their own ledger mode, e.g. KNOWN_UNRUNNABLE_HARNESS, since a must-fail or nondeterministic rule cannot describe a case that has no terminal result
B: do not place these fifteen upstream test functions at all and record that as an explicit, listed deviation from the file-plan's has_tests entries
C: accept a permanently red or hanging ./pkg/... gate line, which the rules do not allow to be reported as a pass
